questions.question: What is the capital of France?
questions.explanation: Paris lies on the River Seine. The Eiffel Tower, which stands in the city, was finished in 1889.

questions.question: What is the capital of Denmark?
questions.explanation: Copenhagen lies on the islands of Zealand and Amager. The Little Mermaid statue sits by its harbour.

questions.question: What is the capital of Italy?
questions.explanation: Rome has a tiny country inside it. It is called Vatican City.

questions.question: What is the capital of Japan?
questions.explanation: Before Tokyo, Kyoto was the capital of Japan for more than a thousand years.

questions.question: What is the capital of Spain?
questions.explanation: Madrid lies in the middle of Spain, far from the sea.

questions.question: What is the capital of Germany?
questions.explanation: The Berlin Wall split the city in two from 1961 until it fell in 1989.

questions.question: What is the capital of Norway?
questions.explanation: Oslo lies at the end of a long fjord, the Oslofjord.

questions.question: What is the capital of Sweden?
questions.explanation: Stockholm is spread over many islands, where Lake Mälaren meets the Baltic Sea.

questions.question: What is the capital of England and of the United Kingdom?
questions.explanation: London lies on the River Thames. The famous bell Big Ben hangs in the clock tower of the Houses of Parliament.

questions.question: What is the capital of the United States?
questions.explanation: The city is named after George Washington, the first president of the United States.

questions.question: What is the capital of China?
questions.explanation: The Forbidden City, a huge palace where emperors once lived, stands in the middle of Beijing.

questions.question: What is the capital of Greece?
questions.explanation: Athens is one of the oldest cities in Europe. The ancient Parthenon temple stands above it.

questions.question: What is the capital of Ireland?
questions.explanation: Dublin lies on the River Liffey, on the east coast of Ireland.

questions.question: What is the capital of Russia?
questions.explanation: The Kremlin and Red Square are in the middle of Moscow.

questions.question: What is the capital of India?
questions.explanation: New Delhi was built in the early 20th century, next to the much older city of Delhi.

questions.question: What is the capital of Portugal?
questions.explanation: Lisbon lies where the River Tagus runs out into the Atlantic Ocean.

questions.question: What is the capital of Poland?
questions.explanation: Warsaw lies on the River Vistula, the longest river in Poland.

questions.question: What is the capital of Austria?
questions.explanation: Vienna lies on the Danube. Mozart and Beethoven both lived and worked there.

questions.question: What is the capital of Thailand?
questions.explanation: Thai people call their capital Krung Thep, which means "city of angels".

questions.question: What is the capital of Iceland?
questions.explanation: Many homes in Reykjavik are heated with hot water that comes from deep underground.

questions.question: What is the capital of Belgium?
questions.explanation: Many offices of the European Union are in Brussels.

questions.question: What is the capital of Hungary?
questions.explanation: The Danube runs through the city. Buda is on one bank and Pest on the other.

questions.question: What is the capital of Scotland?
questions.explanation: Edinburgh has a big castle on a hill made of old volcanic rock.

questions.question: What is the capital of Wales?
questions.explanation: In Wales people speak English, and many also speak the Welsh language.

questions.question: What is the capital of South Korea?
questions.explanation: Seoul lies on the Han River, with mountains all around the city.

questions.question: What is the capital of Canada?
questions.explanation: Ottawa is in the province of Ontario, on a river that forms the border with the province of Quebec.

questions.question: What is the capital of Finland?
questions.explanation: Helsinki lies on the Gulf of Finland, on the Baltic Sea.

questions.question: What is the capital of Australia?
questions.explanation: Canberra was built as a compromise, because Sydney and Melbourne both wanted to be the capital.

questions.question: What is the capital of Cuba?
questions.explanation: Cuba is an island in the Caribbean Sea. Havana lies on its north coast.

questions.question: On which continent is Brazil?
questions.explanation: Brazil has most of the Amazon rainforest, the biggest rainforest on Earth.

questions.question: On which continent is Kenya?
questions.explanation: Kenya is known for safari parks, where people can see lions, elephants and giraffes.

questions.question: On which continent is Japan?
questions.explanation: Japan is a group of islands off the east coast of Asia.

questions.question: On which continent is Canada?
questions.explanation: Canada has coasts on three oceans: the Atlantic, the Pacific and the Arctic.

questions.question: Which country has a land border with Jutland, the part of Denmark on the mainland?
questions.explanation: Jutland is the only part of Denmark that is joined to the rest of the European mainland.

questions.question: Which country is Portugal's only land neighbour?
questions.explanation: Portugal's other border is the Atlantic Ocean, all the way along its west and south coasts.

questions.question: Which country lies across the Øresund strait from Copenhagen?
questions.explanation: Since 2000, a long bridge and tunnel have joined Denmark and Sweden across the Øresund.

questions.question: Which big country lies directly north of the United States?
questions.explanation: Canada has two main languages: English and French.

questions.question: What is the capital of Argentina?
questions.explanation: Buenos Aires lies on the Río de la Plata, a very wide river that runs out into the Atlantic Ocean.

questions.question: What is the capital of the Czech Republic?
questions.explanation: Prague lies on the River Vltava and has a famous old astronomical clock.

questions.question: What is the capital of Ukraine?
questions.explanation: Kyiv lies on the Dnieper river, one of the big rivers of Europe.

questions.question: What is the capital of Kenya?
questions.explanation: Nairobi National Park lies right next to the city, so lions and giraffes can be seen with tall buildings behind them.

questions.question: What is the capital of Turkey?
questions.explanation: Ankara became the capital in 1923, when Turkey became a republic. Istanbul is better known, but it is not the capital.

questions.question: What is the capital of Peru?
questions.explanation: Lima lies on the Pacific coast. Cusco was the capital of the Inca empire.

questions.question: What is the capital of Vietnam?
questions.explanation: Hanoi lies on the Red River in the north of Vietnam.

questions.question: What is the capital of Colombia?
questions.explanation: Bogotá lies high up in the Andes mountains, about 2,600 metres above sea level.

questions.question: What is the capital of Saudi Arabia?
questions.explanation: Riyadh lies in the dry middle of the country, far from the coast.

questions.question: Rabat is the capital of which country?
questions.explanation: Rabat is on the Atlantic coast. Many people think first of Casablanca or Marrakesh, but neither is the capital.

questions.question: Tallinn is the capital of which country?
questions.explanation: Tallinn lies on the Gulf of Finland, only a short ferry trip from Helsinki.

questions.question: What is the capital of Greenland?
questions.explanation: Nuuk lies on the south-west coast of Greenland, beside a long fjord.

questions.question: Kingston is the capital of which Caribbean island country?
questions.explanation: Jamaica lies in the Caribbean Sea, south of Cuba.

questions.question: Which of these South American countries has no coast?
questions.explanation: Bolivia is the only other country in South America without a coast.

questions.question: Which country lies directly south of Kenya?
questions.explanation: Mount Kilimanjaro stands in Tanzania, close to the border with Kenya.

questions.question: Which country shares the Caribbean island of Hispaniola with Haiti?
questions.explanation: Haiti is in the west of the island and the Dominican Republic in the east.

questions.question: Kathmandu is the capital of which country?
questions.explanation: Nepal lies between India and China, in the Himalayas. Mount Everest stands on its border with China.

questions.question: Abu Dhabi is the capital of which country?
questions.explanation: Dubai is the best-known city in the country, but Abu Dhabi is the capital.

questions.question: What is the capital of Ghana?
questions.explanation: Accra lies on the Gulf of Guinea, on the coast of West Africa.

questions.question: What is the capital of Nigeria?
questions.explanation: Abuja was built in the middle of the country. It replaced the coastal city of Lagos as the capital in 1991.

questions.question: What is the capital of Brazil?
questions.explanation: Brasília was built from nothing in the 1950s and became the capital in 1960.

questions.question: Addis Ababa is the capital of which African country?
questions.explanation: Addis Ababa lies high in the mountains. The African Union has its headquarters there.

questions.question: What is the capital of Pakistan?
questions.explanation: Islamabad was planned and built in the 1960s, near green hills in the north of the country.

questions.question: What is the capital of the Philippines?
questions.explanation: The Philippines has more than 7,000 islands. Manila is on Luzon, the largest.

questions.question: What is the capital of Romania?
questions.explanation: Bucharest lies in the south of Romania, south of the Carpathian Mountains.

questions.question: What is the capital of Croatia?
questions.explanation: Zagreb lies inland, away from the Adriatic coast.

questions.question: What is the capital of Slovakia?
questions.explanation: Bratislava lies on the Danube, very close to the borders with Austria and Hungary.

questions.question: What is the capital of Uruguay?
questions.explanation: Montevideo lies on the same wide river estuary as Buenos Aires, the Río de la Plata.

questions.question: Madagascar is a big island off the east coast of which continent?
questions.explanation: Many animals on Madagascar, such as lemurs, live nowhere else in the wild.

questions.question: Fiji is a country of islands in which part of the world?
questions.explanation: Oceania includes Australia, New Zealand and thousands of islands in the Pacific Ocean.

questions.question: Which of these countries is in South America?
questions.explanation: Chile is a very long, thin country between the Andes mountains and the Pacific Ocean.

questions.question: Which of these countries is in Central America?
questions.explanation: Costa Rica has a coast on both the Pacific Ocean and the Caribbean Sea.

questions.question: Which country has land borders with Sweden, Norway and Russia?
questions.explanation: Finland also has a long coast on the Baltic Sea.

questions.question: Which country lies partly in Europe and partly in Asia?
questions.explanation: In Istanbul, the Bosphorus strait divides the European side of the city from the Asian side.

questions.question: Riga is the capital of which country?
questions.explanation: Riga lies where the Daugava river runs out into the Baltic Sea.

questions.question: Amman is the capital of which country?
questions.explanation: Jordan has the Dead Sea on its border and the ancient rock city of Petra in the south.

questions.question: Beirut is the capital of which country?
questions.explanation: Lebanon lies on the eastern shore of the Mediterranean Sea.

questions.question: Valletta is the capital of which island country?
questions.explanation: Malta lies in the Mediterranean Sea, south of the island of Sicily.

questions.question: What is the capital of Uganda?
questions.explanation: Kampala lies close to Lake Victoria, a huge lake that three countries share.

questions.question: What is the capital of Bulgaria?
questions.explanation: Sofia lies at the foot of Mount Vitosha, a popular place for hiking and skiing.

questions.question: Belgrade is the capital of which country?
questions.explanation: Belgrade is where two rivers, the Sava and the Danube, meet.

questions.question: What is the capital of Ecuador?
questions.explanation: Ecuador is named after the Equator, and Quito lies very close to it.

questions.question: Vilnius is the capital of which country?
questions.explanation: Lithuania is the southernmost of the three Baltic countries.

questions.question: Ulaanbaatar is the capital of which country?
questions.explanation: Mongolia lies between Russia and China and has huge grassy plains.

questions.question: What is the capital of Bhutan?
questions.explanation: Bhutan is a small mountain kingdom between India and China.

questions.question: Vientiane is the capital of which country?
questions.explanation: Laos is the only country in South-East Asia with no coast.

questions.question: What is the capital of Cambodia?
questions.explanation: Phnom Penh lies where the Mekong river and the Tonlé Sap river meet.

questions.question: Malé is the capital of which island country?
questions.explanation: The Maldives is a chain of coral islands in the Indian Ocean.

questions.question: Doha is the capital of which country?
questions.explanation: Qatar is a small country on a peninsula that sticks out into the Persian Gulf.

questions.question: Muscat is the capital of which country?
questions.explanation: Oman lies on the south-east corner of the Arabian Peninsula, by the Arabian Sea.

questions.question: What is the capital of Azerbaijan?
questions.explanation: Baku lies on the shore of the Caspian Sea.

questions.question: What is the capital of Armenia?
questions.explanation: Armenia is a mountain country with no coast, between Turkey, Georgia, Azerbaijan and Iran.

questions.question: Tbilisi is the capital of which country in the Caucasus?
questions.explanation: Tbilisi lies on the Kura river, which runs on to the Caspian Sea.

questions.question: What is the capital of Uzbekistan?
questions.explanation: Uzbekistan lies in Central Asia, along the old Silk Road.

questions.question: Bishkek is the capital of which Central Asian country?
questions.explanation: Kyrgyzstan has high mountains, and most of its land lies far above sea level.

questions.question: What is the capital of Bangladesh?
questions.explanation: Bangladesh lies in the delta where the Ganges and Brahmaputra rivers run out into the sea.

questions.question: What is the capital of Papua New Guinea?
questions.explanation: Papua New Guinea covers the eastern half of the island of New Guinea.

questions.question: What is the capital of Fiji?
questions.explanation: Suva lies on Viti Levu, the biggest island of Fiji.

questions.question: Apia is the capital of which Pacific country?
questions.explanation: Samoa lies in the South Pacific Ocean.

questions.question: Bandar Seri Begawan is the capital of which country?
questions.explanation: Brunei lies on the north coast of the island of Borneo.

questions.question: What is the capital of Namibia?
questions.explanation: Namibia has the Namib Desert along its Atlantic coast.

questions.question: Gaborone is the capital of which country?
questions.explanation: Botswana is home to the Okavango Delta, a huge river delta that ends in the desert.

questions.question: What is the capital of Zimbabwe?
questions.explanation: Zimbabwe shares the Victoria Falls with Zambia.

questions.question: What is the capital of Angola?
questions.explanation: Luanda lies on the Atlantic coast of Angola.

questions.question: Kinshasa is the capital of which large African country?
questions.explanation: Kinshasa faces Brazzaville, capital of a different country, across the wide Congo River.

questions.question: What is the capital of Senegal?
questions.explanation: Dakar lies on a peninsula that is the westernmost point of mainland Africa.

questions.question: What is the capital of Madagascar?
questions.explanation: The capital lies in the highlands in the middle of the island, away from the coast.

questions.question: What is the capital of Cameroon?
questions.explanation: Cameroon is called "Africa in miniature" because it has deserts, mountains and rainforest.

questions.question: Kigali is the capital of which country?
questions.explanation: Rwanda is known as the land of a thousand hills.

questions.question: Ouagadougou is the capital of which country?
questions.explanation: Burkina Faso is in West Africa and has no coast.

questions.question: Which country is completely surrounded by South Africa?
questions.explanation: Lesotho lies high in the mountains. Its capital is Maseru.

questions.question: Which of these countries has only landlocked neighbours, so it is "doubly landlocked"?
questions.explanation: Liechtenstein is the only other doubly landlocked country. From both, you must cross at least two borders to reach the ocean.

questions.question: What is the capital of Paraguay?
questions.explanation: Asunción lies on the Paraguay river, the river that gives the country its name.

questions.question: What is the capital of Honduras?
questions.explanation: Honduras has a long Caribbean coast and a short Pacific one. Tegucigalpa lies inland, in a valley among the mountains.

questions.question: What is the capital of Haiti?
questions.explanation: Haiti was the first country in the Caribbean to win its independence, in 1804.

questions.question: Nassau is the capital of which country?
questions.explanation: The Bahamas is made up of hundreds of islands in the Atlantic Ocean.

questions.question: Managua is the capital of which Central American country?
questions.explanation: Managua lies on the shore of Lake Managua. Nicaragua also has the large Lake Nicaragua.

questions.question: Sarajevo is the capital of which country?
questions.explanation: Sarajevo lies in a valley among mountains and hosted the Winter Olympics in 1984.

questions.question: What is the capital of the Faroe Islands?
questions.explanation: The Faroe Islands lie in the North Atlantic, about halfway between Norway and Iceland.

questions.question: Vaduz is the capital of which small country in the Alps?
questions.explanation: Liechtenstein lies between Switzerland and Austria, by the River Rhine.

questions.question: What is the capital of Albania?
questions.explanation: Albania lies on the Adriatic and Ionian seas, across from the heel of Italy.

questions.question: What is the capital of Moldova?
questions.explanation: Moldova lies between Romania and Ukraine.

questions.question: Lilongwe is the capital of which country?
questions.explanation: Lake Malawi, one of Africa's great lakes, runs along much of the country's eastern side.
